site.name: Quant Trading Learn
site.description: A self-contained quant trading study site for programmers/ML engineers: concepts, formulas, Python demos, quizzes, and local progress. Learning only — not investment advice.

home.title: From programmer to systematic trading research
home.lead: Self-contained lessons: prep → markets & data → backtests → strategies & factors → risk & execution → capstone. Progress stays in your browser.
home.disclaimer: This site teaches research methods and engineering workflow only. No buy/sell advice, stock tips, or live-trading order tutorials. Code snippets are educational.
home.how1: Each lesson has goals, explanation, formulas, and Python demos; external links are optional.
home.how2: Instant quiz feedback; task checklist and completion live in localStorage.
home.how3: Focus on traps, costs, and out-of-sample thinking before clever strategies.
home.progressLocal: Progress is stored only in this browser (localStorage) and is never uploaded.
